data.explanation: Your car insurer needs your version of the accident to determine who is liable, because the other driver already filed a claim against you. Fill out and return the accident questionnaire (Fragebogen zum Unfallhergang) by the deadline shown, describing exactly how the collision occurred. This is not a court deadline, but delaying your reply can slow down or negatively affect the handling of the liability question and your insurance coverage. If you are unsure about liability or fault, it can help to write down the facts carefully or ask the insurer for clarification before sending the form back.
